questions.q: The primary reason for a business entity to prepare Departmental Accounts is to
options: Determine the individual profitability and operational efficiency of each distinct department
Combine all indirect expenses into a single figure to lower business income tax
Satisfy mandatory statutory requirements applicable only to sole proprietorships
Eliminate the need to prepare a combined final Balance Sheet for the business
questions.explain: **Departmental Accounts** are prepared by dividing a multi-activity business into distinct segments. This enables management to evaluate the operational performance, gross profit, and net profit of each department individually, identifying which lines are performing well and which are unprofitable.
